scope: Final bounded search, retain inliers AND quality; no automatic commit/push; no next stage
development: DTU scan1/6 only; all old validation data already observed, not blind; lock selected candidate BEFORE new-family predictions
candidate_definition: legacy unchanged EPnP RANSAC; lm accepted legacy PnP with at most3 LM/reclassification rounds each max20 iterations eps1e-8 in normalized coordinates. Reject local step if full-K positive pixel support decreases or sum truncated squared2px cost increases. ap3p same1000 iterations/confidence.999/2px normalized threshold, change only minimal solver; ap3p_lm combines. No threshold tuning. No resurrection of rejected initial PnP by LM. Same full BA20evaluations/5seconds. No GT in reconstruction. Standard component engineering, no algorithm novelty claim.
development_selection: Compare inliers candidate to inliers legacy, C primary, scan1/6 equally weighted over4conditions and5seeds. Eligible if score10 improves and severe/false do not increase and accurate_scene nondecreasing. Pick maximum score10 among eligible, lexical solver tie. If none eligible choose lm for fixed external falsification and mark no development winner. No further candidate generation. Keep all4arms for external comparisons and report multiple testing; only locked selected candidate can pass confirmatory gate.

tum.selection: First7 RGB regular-file members in official TAR archive order, then sort selected filenames. normal/blur first5, reduced first3, spaced indices0/3/6. Fixed archive order, no GT/imagequality overlap selection. Fetch ONLY first8MiB compressed prefix per scene; stop if fewer than7 images, preserve unavailable cases without substitutes. Official groundtruth text separately. Nearest GT within20ms; no frame reselection. Gaussian radius4 ORIGINAL before undistort, cv2.undistort same K bilinear black border retained, no crop,640x480. RGB only, do not use depth.
tum.reference: motion-capture optical-center C2W quaternion xyzw; invert to W2C; nearest-frame temporal uncertainty explicitly reported

south_building.selection: Lexicographic first5 and fixed spaced indices0/63/127 of128 images. Read images and cameras/images text through HTTP ranges only, NO database or point cloud. Conditions same; preservefull image aspect800x600, originalblur4 then undistort atnativeK thenresize. Parse COLMAP SIMPLE_RADIAL K and radial distortion, W2C qvec wxyz and translation. Same derived fixed K for all strategies.
south_building.reference: Provided SfM sample reconstruction, NOT independent ground truth; report separately, cannot alone establish accuracy improvement

metric: failure-aware linear joint pose score5/10/20 allplannedpairs denominator, accurate complete map<=5deg, false>5deg and severe>20deg counts/rates, correct cameras, registration; per-scene/family/seed tails, CPU/RSS/GPU/time. Retain all negative/unknown/OOM and map candidates. Paired scenes are independent unit, seeds/conditions correlated. No statistical significance claims from seed count.
promotion: Five families completed; selected candidate C score10 positive in BOTH genuinely new families, >=0 elsewhere, accurate complete-map rate notlower and false/severe rates nothigher in EACH family; no scene severe increase. At least1pp equally weighted family score10 gain OR>=10% false reduction with score nondecrease qualifies material benefit. For safety compare fixed as well to prevent inlier ranking harm hidden. New-family South SfM proxy cannot prove independent accuracy: require TUM positive and independent DTU withheld scan9/10/11 nonregression. Stable claim requires all gates, otherwise report conditional tradeoff/NO_GO; never continue test-set tuning until positive.
stop: Finish fixed4candidates x2rankings x2frontends x5seeds xplannedconditions. One development selection; no extra candidates/threshold changes/data substitutions after outcomes. Access failures remain unavailable, not passed. Report honest no stable winner if gates fail. Retain both old rankings irrespective outcome.
